content:
Parādījusies jauna lapa https://osm.dodies.lv/

Šobrīd izmanto

man_made=tower
tower:type=observation
observation=firewatch

bet tas wiki nav aprakstīts (izņemot šeit https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/WikiProject_Emergency_Cleanup/Emergency_Tags)
liekas ka emergency=fire_lookout ir populārāks (un ir ar wiki lapu)


zils - observation=firewatch, sarkans emergency=fire_lookout, zaļš abi kopā (tikai baltkrievi?)

domas?

[out:json][timeout:25];
(
  nwr["emergency"="fire_lookout"]({{bbox}});
  nwr["observation"="firewatch"]({{bbox}});
);
out geom;

{{style:
*[observation=firewatch]
{ color: #377eb8; fill-color:#377eb8; }
*[emergency=fire_lookout]
{ color: #FF0000; fill-color:#FF0000; }
*[emergency=fire_lookout][observation=firewatch]
{ color: #1BBF0F; fill-color:#1BBF0F; }

overpass ja kāds grib paskatīties tuvāk
